answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 48759 Country: India Title: Taharah Question: As I also want to know that the spot of (Ihtilam) is left after washing the cloth very nicely, but still the spot is left and the hardness at place still remain after the hand wash, so can we offer the namaz from that cloth where that spot still remains? Answer ID: 48759 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1371/1057/D=11/1434) The cloth turns pure after washing three times by rubbing. If the spot remains it will not harm, you may offer salah in that cloth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
